verdict.rationale: a-Shell has no conventional public API: the OpenAPI probes all returned 404 and there is no llms.txt. Its documented programmatic surface is Apple Shortcuts integration, described as giving users "full control of the Shell" so they can download, process and release files using a-Shell commands. That is a real but platform-bound automation interface rather than a public API. missing for 10: a documented public API (REST/SDK/OpenAPI) reference, detailed docs of the Shortcuts actions and parameters, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent-driven automation.
